spl_product_data_elements: La Flecha Japonesa Methyl salicylate CAJUPUT OIL CLOVE OIL PEPPERMINT OIL EUCALYPTUS OIL JUNIPER BERRY OIL MENTHOL MINERAL OIL METHYL SALICYLATE SALICYLIC ACID
active_ingredient: Drug Facts Active Ingredients Purpose Methyl Salicate 10.5%..............................................................External Analgesic
indications_and_usage: Uses For the temporary relief of minor aches and pains of muscles and joints associated with: simple backache arthrits strains sprains
warnings: For external use only. Do not use otherwise than as directed.
do_not_use: Do not use with a bandage on wounds or damage skin with a heating pad on a child under 12 years of age over extensive areas of the body on irritated skin
ask_doctor: Ask a doctor before use if you have redness over the affected area
when_using: When using this product avoid contact with eyes or mucuos membranes do not bandage
stop_use: Stop use and ask a doctor if condition worsen or symptoms persists for more than 7 days symptoms clear up and occur again within a few days excessive skin irritation occurs
pregnancy_or_breast_feeding: if pregnant or breast-feeding ask a health professional before use
keep_out_of_reach_of_children: Keep out of the reach of children to avoid accidental poisoning. If swallowed, induce vomiting and call a physician or contact a Poison Control Center right away.
dosage_and_administration: Directions use only as directed adults and children 12 years of age and older: apply to affected area no more than 3 to 4 times daily children under 12 years of age: ask a doctor
other_safety_information: Other information store at 15° to 25° C (59° to 77° F)
inactive_ingredient: Inactive Ingredients cajeput oil, clove oil, essential oil of peppermint, eucalyptus oil, juniper, menthol, white mineral oil.
questions: Questions? 1-800-560-5223 M-F 9 AM to 4 PM Eastern.
